verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
I'll remind myself
Of all that You've done
And the life I have
Because of Your Son

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Love came down and rescued me
Love came down and set me free
Now I am Yours
I am forever Yours
Mountain high or valley low
I sing out, remind my soul
That I am Yours
I am forever Yours

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
I am Yours
I am Yours
All my days
Jesus, I am Yours

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines:
If my heart is overwhelmed
And I cannot hear Your voice
I hold on to what is true
Though I cannot see

verse.name: v1e
verse.lines:
If the storms of life they come
And the road ahead gets steep
I will lift these hands in faith
I will believe

verse.name: v1f
verse.lines:
When my heart is filled with hope
Every promise comes my way
When I feel Your hands of grace
Rest upon me

verse.name: v1g
verse.lines:
Staying desperate for You, God
Staying humble at Your feet
I will lift these hands in praise
I will believe

verse.name: v1h
verse.lines:
You came down and rescued me
You came down and set me free
Now I am Yours
I am forever Yours
Mountain high or valley low
I sing out, remind my soul
That I am Yours
I am forever Yours
